fact: In a memorandum of 21 September 2026 OLPA reported journalists and radio technicians held by intelligence agents or police in Kalemie, Likasi and Kabinda in August and September 2026, one prosecuted for defamation.
title: RDC : l'OLPA alerte sur la multiplication des atteintes à la liberté de la presse et interpelle le ministère de l'Intérieur
